agents.role: AI participant, one per original participant (60 recruited, 51 / 50 analysed)

roles.participant: listener (Exp 1; also sender in four practice trials) / speaker (Exp 2)
roles.message_sender_exp1: scripted: the message is generated from the design (is_e1_snd)

scripted_roles.justification: Messages shown to listeners are fixed by the stimulus design (trigger message); whether they came from real previous participants is not stated in the paper.

assignment: within-participant; all trial types in one randomized sequence of 66 trials (Exp 1 preceded by 4 speaker trials)
order: sequential per participant; one model call per trial; each prompt contains the participant's own earlier trials and choices only; no feedback
visibility: participants never see other participants' responses
